Sweet, clean and intoxicating, bright tones of lily-of-the-valley open the fragrance, warmed by a serene heart of amber and gurjan balsam. Woody and earthy base notes balance the opening beautifully, mingling smoky oud and tonka bean with labdanum, tolu balsam and musk to produce an arresting, alluring trail that lasts all day.
